snapshot_kind: standalone fixed-case full-action campaign; not a normalized-v1 cohort member

binding.scope: Public documentation and curated evidence for a private implementation; not an executable public target release or multi-case ranking.

developer_visible: counted aggregate feedback only when n > 0
executing_controller_visible: legitimate one-step forecast simulation from current real state
evaluator_only: target real observation and action traces

artifact.python_cache_policy: validate ordinary raw cache files before excluding them from the execution copy; raw caches still count toward limits

feedback.same_key_same_hash: existing logical job without additional credit
feedback.infrastructure_recovery: same credit, bounded attempts, original developer clock

protocol.cutoff_policy: Certify an immutable paused/frozen source before the hard development deadline; separately attest bounded physical stop and read-only hash-matched terminal transfer. A universal stopped-before-deadline claim is not made.

scoring.game_over: valid completed native evaluation with native economic score, even when the weekly episode is incomplete

infrastructure_failure.interpretation: missing score; scalar zero placeholder is not an algorithm score

scoring.successful_steps: real transitions whose trusted native has_error is false
scoring.executed_steps: all real transitions, including any failed terminal transition
scoring.episode_complete: successful_steps equals horizon and status is completed

case_selection.rule: Ascending best native economic score across the three preserved mature controllers; alias ascending breaks exact ties.
case_selection.limits: Baseline-conditioned difficult fixed-case selection, not representative multi-case sampling or unseen-case generalization.

statistics_policy.primary_scope: All three retained valid terminal candidates for each budget, including the flagged interrupted n1-r3.
statistics_policy.sample_standard_deviation: Bessel-corrected sample SD with denominator count minus one.
statistics_policy.completed_workflow_only_n1_summary: Supplementary accounting for the two completed n1 workflows; no new protocol exclusion or replacement run.

groups.scope: all three retained valid terminal candidates, including any flagged interrupted developer workflow
all three retained valid terminal candidates, including any flagged interrupted developer workflow
all three retained valid terminal candidates, including any flagged interrupted developer workflow
all three retained valid terminal candidates, including any flagged interrupted developer workflow

completed_workflow_only_n1.scope: supplementary completed-workflow-only accounting; does not redefine or exclude any original protocol repetition

workflow_failure.root_cause_limit: No specific upstream HTTP status, rate-limit cause or general network root cause established.

audit_scopes.metadata: Original 15 role and Job identities, unique Pod ownership, current source bindings and terminal status counts checked against submission receipts.
audit_scopes.outputs: All 181 disk and archive members hash-verified; all 15 signed payload scores match complete records and trusted reward-details, and cutoff/submission/terminal/graded source maps agree.
audit_scopes.runtime_signatures: All 15 certificates report actual in-place frozen verifier HMAC success without key export; public evidence does not independently expose or audit the keys.
audit_scopes.usage: Raw model usage independently recomputed by the root auditor; compact aggregate consistency separately checked.
audit_scopes.baseline_source_hashes: Original private result receipts and per-profile receipt digests; only numeric aggregates are copied here.

provenance.published_content_scope: Curated portable aggregates and opaque provenance digests only; no raw private packet, host path, credential, signing key, chronics, real target observation/reference trace or candidate source/weight payload.

limitations: The fixed target case and seeds are disclosed and reused for counted feedback and terminal evaluation; this does not measure unseen-case generalization.
The organizer selected a difficult week using mature baselines before formal results; the result is conditional on that selection rule.
Valid native game-over grades are distinct from completing the full episode or successfully completing every developer workflow.
All original repetitions remain represented; the interrupted developer grade is retained and flagged.
This standalone snapshot does not add L2RPN to the pre-existing normalized-v1 cohort or release an executable public binding.

algorithm_sources.evidence_level: source-only static inspection of a common starter and three representative retained terminal controllers

sources.lineage: byte-identical to the starter in the frozen V4 task source closure

scope_limits: Function locations identify implemented source mechanisms, not branches demonstrated to execute on a particular target transition.
No mechanism was ablated and no score improvement is causally attributed to a source component.
Source comments do not independently reconstruct development history.
Protected aggregate feedback budget n is distinct from the common per-action simulation interface, which is also available to n0 controllers.
